title: Batch Health Check Windows
source: 452. Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
brief: Our deploy orchestrator gives every rolling service a window on the timeline during which it is safe to probe it. A single health check fired at one instant covers every service whose window contains that instant, and each check is expensive, so we want to fire as few as possible while still covering every service.

Implement fewestHealthChecks(windows), where windows lists the service windows as [start, end] pairs, and return the smallest number of check instants needed so that every window contains at least one of them.
